newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan October ethylene production up 5.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan October ethylene production up 5.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's ethylene output rose 5.6 percent in October from a year earlier to 568,000 tonnes, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Thursday.
October production grew year-on-year because only three ethylene plants were shut for routine maintenance last month, compared with five in the same period a year ago, a MITI official said.
Ethylene output for the January to October period totalled 5.89 million tonnes, he said.

If petrochemical firms maintain the average operating rate at ethylene centres at above 95 percent for the remaining months of the year, Japan's annual ethylene production is likely to top seven million tonnes for the first time ever, he added.
Ethylene plants' operating rates averaged about 99 percent in October.
